Review a simulation-based design recommendation

Source: R/api-design-recommendation.R
summary.mfrm_design_recommendation.Rd

Review a simulation-based design recommendation

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_design_recommendation'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.mfrm_design_recommendation'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_design_recommendation'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

object, x

Output from recommend_mfrm_design().

...

Unused; extra arguments are rejected.

Value

summary() returns a summary.mfrm_design_recommendation list containing target, thresholds, checks, design_table, facet_table, recommended, and notes. Print methods return their input invisibly.

Details

Recommendations screen the saved simulation aggregates under the requested criteria. The default targets non-Person facet calibration. For Person differentiation, request facets = "Person" when recommending the design. Neither target establishes classification accuracy, inter-rater agreement, a universal minimum sample size or precision outside the simulated population.

checks has one row per design, target facet and criterion, including unavailable metrics and inactive constraints. DesignRow links these rows to the complete, ranked design_table. Selected marks the first passing plan under the stored prefer order; it does not establish an optimum over unevaluated plans. Pass and selected plans are reused without recalculation. Threshold sources are recorded for new results; older saved results show not_recorded. No confidence intervals or selection-adjusted uncertainty are calculated. Retain the simulation's generating assumptions and replication evidence with the recommendation.

See also

recommend_mfrm_design(), plot.mfrm_design_recommendation(), mfrm_report(), export_summary_appendix()

Examples

# Saved synthetic simulation; one replication illustrates structure only.
saved <- readRDS(system.file("examples", "simulation-design.rds",
  package = "mfrmr", mustWork = TRUE))
rec <- recommend_mfrm_design(saved$result, facets = "Person")
summary(rec)
#> Simulation-based design recommendation
#>   Facet                 Target
#>  Person Person differentiation
#>                                                                                   Interpretation
#>  Distinguishing Persons in the simulated population; not classification accuracy at a cut score.
#> 
#>  0 of 2 evaluated designs pass.
#> No evaluated design meets all requested criteria.
#> Use $checks for all criterion outcomes and $thresholds for their source.
#> This screen does not establish agreement, classification accuracy or a universal sample size.
report <- mfrm_report(rec)
report$tables$checks
